name: Bolster Short Arc Quad
steps: Lie on your back on a firm, comfortable surface with a foam roller or rolled bolster placed horizontally under your target knee.
Allow your heel to rest on the floor with your knee bent at roughly a 20 to 30 degree angle over the bolster.
Keeping the back of your knee resting against the bolster, slowly straighten your lower leg by contracting the quadriceps on the front of your thigh.
Extend the knee until your leg is fully straight and your heel lifts completely off the floor.
Hold the straight-leg contraction for 3 to 5 seconds, focusing on squeezing the vastus medialis just above your knee.
Slowly lower your heel back down to the floor with control.
coaching_cues: Do not lift your thigh or knee off the bolster; keep the back of the knee anchored to isolate terminal extension.
Keep your toes pointed straight up toward the ceiling throughout the movement.
Contract your thigh muscles firmly at the top without hyperextending violently.

sources.attribution: AAOS Knee Conditioning & Post-Operative Rehabilitation Protocol
